headline: ESMA sets CSRD enforcement priorities as green claims scrutiny increases
summary: ESMA has outlined enforcement focus areas for CSRD sustainability disclosures, directly affecting your FY2027 reporting preparation. Meanwhile, regulators are stepping up scrutiny of green claims, requiring strict substantiation for packaging and product marketing. The EU Council also agreed a position on packaging rule simplifications.

items.title: ESMA publishes enforcement priorities for CSRD sustainability reporting
items.what: ESMA highlighted double materiality, impact and risk identification, and target setting as key focus areas for sustainability disclosures.
items.meaning: As a listed entity in scope for FY2027, your upcoming sustainability statements will be examined against these specific enforcement criteria.
items.action: Align materiality assessments and supply chain target setting with ESMA focal points.

sources.title: ESMA to Focus on Materiality, Impacts, Risks, Opportunities and Targets as Sustainability Reporting Enforcement Priorities

items.title: Regulators issue guidance and enforce rules on green claims
items.what: ESMA issued guidance on climate claims, while the Commission secured commitments against misleading environmental packaging statements.
items.meaning: Environmental claims on power tool packaging and battery platforms sold to EU consumers face strict legal substantiation standards.
items.action: Audit consumer-facing packaging and marketing claims for verifiable technical evidence.

sources.title: ESMA Guidance on Impact and Climate Transition Claims
EU Commission secures recycling claim changes from Coca-Cola, Nestlé and Danone
Now That EU Green Transition Rules Are in Force, Which Cosmetic Packaging Claims Are Off-Limits?

items.title: EFRAG consults on 2027–2029 sustainability reporting work plan
items.what: EFRAG launched a public consultation on its priorities for future ESRS development and standards maintenance.
items.meaning: Future standards will determine how deep supply chain disclosures must go, affecting data collection from your Chinese suppliers.
items.action: Review consultation topics to prepare supplier sustainability data gathering systems.

sources.title: EU CSRD: EFRAG launched consultation on its 2027–2029 sustainability reporting agenda, Julia Voskoboinikova

items.title: Council agrees stance on packaging rules simplification
items.what: The EU Council agreed its negotiating position to streamline compliance requirements for small packaging producers under proposed packaging rules.
items.meaning: Final negotiations will set packaging design and waste requirements for your imported finished goods from mainland China.
items.action: Track PPWR negotiation progress to inform future supplier packaging guidelines.

sources.title: Simplification: Council agrees negotiating stance to cut red tape for small packaging producers
